name: Earthfall
routine:
(5 minutes) Only the first five minutes of this disaster directly impact the PCs, but during that time, they must contend with the combination of a megatsunami and meteor shower.
Meteor Shower: As Meteor Shower, but 7d10 bludgeoning damage and 15d6 fire damage to all characters (DC 42 basic Reflex save save). If at least half the PCs succeeded at Prepare checks, only one randomly determined PC is affected by the meteor shower rather than the whole party.
Tsunami: If at least half the PCs succeed on Prepare checks, they avoid all effects of the megatsunami until the last minute, at which point they're affected as if they were unprepared. Many of Xin-Bakrakhan's citizens are powerful wizards or otherwise have access to flight, be it by spell, wings, or flying minions, but their retreat into the skies above is chaotic. A PC capable of flight (or who is carried aloft by a flying ally) for an entire minute can avoid the tsunami's effects if they succeed at a DC 35 Acrobatics check check to Maneuver in Flight to avoid mid-air collisions with others or falling meteors—on a failure they're forced back into the dangerous waters below and take a –2 circumstance penalty to saves against the tsunami's effects.
The tsunami floods into the lowest elevation area on the 2nd minute, then proceeds up into the higher regions as shown on the map on each of the following minutes. A PC in the area is affected as the standard megatsunami, but 6d12+35 bludgeoning damage (DC 42 basic Fortitude save save) when they're first struck and then 4d12+25 bludgeoning damage (DC 40 basic Reflex save) each minute they're carried along by the wave.
text:
Variant Megatsunami and Meteor Shower
Anticipate DC 42 Astronomy-lore check (master) or DC 45 Nature check (legendary) to chart the meteor's trajectory, DC 50 Society check (master) to recall information on Xin-Bakrakhan and how it was destroyed during Earthfall
Prepare DC 42 Ocean-lore check (expert) or DC 45 Nature check (master) or DC 45 Survival check (master) to chart the flood paths of the coming waves, DC 50 Crafting check (legendary) to reinforce a shelter
